desc:
Welcome to Ragdoll Labs - the most realistic ragdoll game on Roblox!

Every dummy reacts for real: they flinch, stumble, crawl, panic, mourn their friends and go flying. Shoot them, launch them, crush them - and let the physics do the rest.

NEW: HITMAN MISSION - you voted for it! Find your target in the crowd, ONE clean shot.

THE REAPER PACK - fly on huge crow wings, mark dummies for death, call a murder of crows and ring the Death Bell!

MAPS: The Lab, White Room, Construction, Demolition, Gun Range, Castle + THE ARENA, Circus
MISSIONS: Home Invasion, Hostage Rescue, Hitman

• Tons of weapons - guns, snipers, melee, throwables, explosives and gadgets
• Power packs - Reaper, God, Devil and Hero: fly, smite, possess a dummy and more
• Free slow-mo for everyone, Time Stop, daily rewards, leaderboards

B: weapons • N: spawn a dummy • Z: ragdoll • T: slow-mo • G: time stop • V: 1st person
Fully playable on phone, PC and controller!

New stuff every update - Like + Favorite!
